snippet.title: EvoCreo 2 Steam Release Trailer
snippet.description:
EvoCreo 2 is a monster capture RPG inspired by Pokémon. Capture over 300 unique Creo, explore diverse regions, and battle your way through a story-rich, monster-catching RPG. Start your adventure in the world of Shoru as you uncover the plot of a nefarious group, Free Cognito.

Available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317290?utm_source=youtube&utm_term=ec2_release

Also on Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ilmfinity.evocreo_2
and iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/evocreo2-monster-trainer-rpg/id1499001662

Community Links

Follow us on Instagram:  https://www.instagram.com/evocreo.official
